messages:
rachel: quick idea: 'bucket-manifest' that sits between manifest_lite and full index. coarse buckets + per-bucket hot-score + optional sample-offsets. goal: better than sketch, cheaper than full index.

maya: short: yes please. how big is a bucket blob?

rachel: target ~1-4KB per shard. bucket_size tunable (eg 16KB) and we keep a vector of hot-scores + 2 sample offsets per hot bucket. loader can do 2 small reads per hot bucket to validate.

sam: sounds practical. loader change surface?

rachel: loader accepts `bucket_manifest` blob and a runtime hint `warmup.strategy=BUCKETED`. scheduler will: 1) pick top N buckets by hot-score, 2) coalesce adjacent buckets, 3) read sample offsets then expand if samples validate.

cheng: eviction and IOPs? reading samples still creates many small reads.

rachel: mitigate: coalesce at bucket granularity, default coalesce_window = 64KB, async scatter if transport supports it, and an io_budget cap. if budget exceeded, fallback to whole-shard read.

anita: telemetry we need?

sam: add: bucket_manifest_hit_rate, sample_validation_rate, bucket_coalesce_efficiency, warmup_extra_io_pct.

maya: compatibility: indexer emits bucket_manifest for safetensors; other formats map into same canonical buckets. catalog stores it as part of weight metadata.

rachel: failure modes: stale bucket_scores -> increased reads. mitigation: background bucket_revalidate job and experimental TTL on bucket_manifest.

perf-bot: queued: bucket-manifest-spike-2026-03-23-04. will report p50/p95 cold-start and io delta.

sam: rollout: feature-flagged, default off, canary on dedicated pool for 2 weeks. if p95 improves >10% and io_delta < 15% keep experimenting.

rachel: i'll draft a short RFC with schema, loader signature, and rollout checklist. will post link here when ready. thanks :thumbsup:
